code_identity_contract.submission_value: EXPECTED_COMMIT is the full 40-character candidate SHA supplied to qsub
code_identity_contract.required_equality: EXPECTED_COMMIT == clean worktree HEAD == manifest identities.code.commit

frozen_workload.outer_optimizer: SGD with momentum 0.9 learning rate 0.1 and updated-buffer Nesterov
frozen_workload.control: SGD with momentum zero learning rate one and no Nesterov

numeric_contract.pseudo_gradient: for contribution i compute float32 G_f at the proposal-declared base version minus float32 L_i,f
numeric_contract.merge: in frozen selection order accumulate float32 weight_i times pseudo-gradient_i into a float32 fragment accumulator
numeric_contract.application: apply the merged gradient to current G_f^v and current fragment outer state O_f^v
numeric_contract.single_update_relative_l2: norm(production minus Stage0 oracle)_2 divided by max(norm(oracle)_2, 1e-12) must be at most 1e-6
numeric_contract.fifty_update_gate: every one of 50 relative L2 errors is at most 1e-6 and max(last ten) is no greater than max(max(first ten), 1e-7)
numeric_contract.order_gate: each of 16 deterministic contribution permutations differs from the canonical direct merge by relative L2 at most 1e-6

memory_contract.source_lifetime: each selected local payload is opened through a context-managed lease and released before the next contribution
memory_contract.active_payload_gate: maximum simultaneous local payload leases is exactly one for a nonempty update
memory_contract.tensor_ledger_gate: instrumented live tensor bytes never exceed eight times one fragment payload and do not scale with M times fragment size
memory_contract.rss_observation: dedicated warmed child processes reset the observation at production-kernel entry and sample current Linux VmRSS at each target-update allocation checkpoint through successor creation for identical M=1 and M=8 fragment shapes; lifetime VmHWM is recorded only as non-gating context
memory_contract.rss_gate: M=8 peak RSS minus M=1 peak RSS is at most 12 MiB
memory_contract.cache_all_counterexample: the RED surrogate holds all eight source leases and must report eight live payloads

byte_accounting.observation_interval: entry through successful return of exactly one target-fragment update
byte_accounting.local_reads: sum of exact selected local payload byte lengths
byte_accounting.base_reads: zero for a current resident base and exact payload bytes for each resolver read of a retained noncurrent base
byte_accounting.current_and_output: one current fragment input and one successor fragment output
byte_accounting.forbidden: no full-model load save stack concatenate or assembly operation
byte_accounting.acceptance: every trace operation names the selected fragment and no operation byte count equals or includes the F-fragment model

update_identity.mutation_rule: changing any required semantic fact changes the canonical SHA-256 update identity

formal_package: S1-00 builder finalizer and validator with clean code config source skill scheduler role path and checksum identities plus fail-if-exists root
failure_ladder: preserve the first formal L2 package and reproduce writer plus syncer on one compute node with the same candidate and profile before any resubmission
